## Summary

Describe the catalogue, website, or automation change.

## Evidence

List the primary paper, venue, repository, model, dataset, or license URLs used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched for an existing record before adding a new one.
- [ ] Formal venues and open-source claims are supported by evidence.
- [ ] English and Chinese summaries are concise and factual where applicable.
- [ ] `python3 automation/validate_data.py` passes.
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s automation/tests -v` passes.
- [ ] `node --check app.js` and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, private data, or copyrighted full-text papers are included.
